quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A summary (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A summary) on the company's global-niche-top (GNT) products for its fiscal 2025 (year ended March 2026): of total net sales of JPY 880 hundred million, GNT products were JPY 545 hundred million - single-wafer cleaning equipment for silicon wafer manufacturing 92, photomask manufacturing equipment 35, high-temperature phosphoric acid etching equipment for wafer processing 149, and flip-chip bonders including bonders for advanced packaging 266 (JPY hundred million). quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A summary (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A summary) on its fiscal 2026 (year ending March 2027) outlook: total net sales expected at JPY 990 hundred million, of which GNT products JPY 675 hundred million - silicon wafer cleaning equipment 80, photomask manufacturing equipment 75, high-temperature phosphoric acid etching equipment 175, flip-chip bonders including advanced-packaging bonders 340 (JPY hundred million). The company does not publish an orders forecast, but says orders overall are trending up and it assumes a level above fiscal 2025; it expects phosphoric acid etching equipment and flip-chip bonders including advanced-packaging bonders to keep leading growth. Separately, management aims to reach ROS of 20% or more within the vision period through fiscal 2032, continuing growth investment while harvesting returns from Phase 2.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A summary (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A summary) on bonders: competition across back-end processes is very intense, but the position differs between tools already in mass production and tools still in evaluation. The TFC-6500-W and TFC-6600 flip-chip bonders are in mass production, contributing to sales, and are expected to grow further in fiscal 2026. The TFC-6800 hybrid bonder is being evaluated jointly with customers; evaluation is progressing smoothly on both sides, it is built into the forecast only as evaluation tools with no large sales expected, fiscal 2026 is an evaluation year and mass production and a sales contribution are still some way off. Management says the tool must combine higher throughput with even higher accuracy; the company is also evaluating its pre-bond treatment (cleaning / plasma) systems with customers, giving it a good position to offer a combined proposal, and while a bundled proposal and adoption is preferred, adoption of either system alone would not be a problem or a disadvantage.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A summary (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A summary) on new products and markets: the high-temperature phosphoric acid etching equipment has its track record in logic; the company will widen its logic customer base and is doing R&D to enter memory, with evaluations under way toward mass production. New GNT products - a wet spin system for panels (for larger, square substrates in the mid-end process, drawing on its FPD large-substrate and spin-cleaning technology) and a FOSB / FOUP cleaning system (to raise cleanliness inside FOUPs for yield) - have evaluation tools installed in the new development building, with the panel tool also at some customers and the FOUP tool in customer field verification. Other advanced-packaging bonder models are in development for customer needs, and next-generation items such as photonic-electronic convergence are at a basic study stage; the company declined to give details.
